description: MaterializerBootstrapPhase: keep stall-on-failure for tag 0 only; data shards may complete recovery with placeholder coverage (slot filled with placeholder pid). Cold clusters exercise on-demand machinery on first touch. Update recovery tests; add integration test: recovery completes with a data-shard materializer forced to fail, first read to that shard materializes on demand.

comments.text: Workflow: branch from feature/q67-phase-a, PR into it (CI now fires on such PRs). DESIGN NOTE: the placeholder pid is unknown during recovery (Distributor starts AFTER recovery, FDB-style) — so relaxation is two-part: (1) bootstrap phase stalls only for tag 0, leaving failed data-shard slots ABSENT; (2) the Distributor's first act at startup is a coverage sweep: diff shard_layout vs shard_materializers and publish the placeholder into uncovered slots (apply_tsl_delta for now; Phase B swaps the publication mechanism). The q67.1 LayoutIndex loud-failure backstop covers the brief window between recovery completion and the sweep.

title: Recovery relaxation: stall only for system shard, placeholder coverage for data shards
